title: Bunny Model Studio training configuration
description: One training run, declared. Every section is closed (additionalProperties false) so a misspelled key is a refusal rather than a silently ignored setting - a run that trained at the default learning rate because 'learning_rate' was spelled 'lr' is indistinguishable from one that trained at the requested rate until the results disagree. There is deliberately no network, upload or telemetry section: network access is granted per invocation at the command line and can never be granted by a document that a dataset author could also have written.

base.description: The base model: a Hugging Face repository identifier or a local directory.

revision.description: The exact revision to use. 'main' is accepted and recorded, but a run whose provenance must be reproducible should name a commit.

trust_remote_code.description: Always false. Present so that a configuration asking for it is refused with a reason rather than silently ignored: remote code is arbitrary code from a model author, executed with the user's privileges, and Bunny does not run it.

method.description: lora trains adapters over a full-precision base; qlora trains adapters over a quantized base and requires the quantization section.

batch_size.description: A positive integer, or 'auto' to size it from measured free VRAM. 'auto' resolves to 1 when memory could not be measured.

precision.description: auto defers to the canonical precision decision. An explicit value that the hardware cannot support blocks the run rather than being downgraded.

max_steps.description: Stop after this many optimizer steps regardless of epochs. 0 means no limit.

target_modules.description: Module names to adapt. Absent means the backend's default for the base architecture, which is recorded in the plan so the run is still reproducible.

path.description: A local path. Remote dataset identifiers are not accepted: a training corpus is the most private thing in this subsystem and it does not leave the machine to be assembled.

validation_split.description: Fraction held out for evaluation. 0 means no held-out set, and the evaluation report then says so rather than reporting training loss as if it were validation loss.

policy_check.description: Whether the permission-model lint runs. It may be disabled only for a corpus that has been reviewed another way, and the choice is recorded in provenance.
